t: Dulux Pure Brilliant White is a water-based matt emulsion paint designed for interior walls and ceilings. Ideal for trade professionals and DIYers working on renovations, this paint provides excellent coverage of 13m²/Ltr. The unique smooth and creamy texture ensures easy application with a brush or roller, leaving a modern, flat finish that helps disguise minor surface imperfections. With a quick touch-dry and recoat time of 2 to 4 hours, decorators can complete jobs efficiently. This low-odour paint features a trace VOC level, making it suitable for occupied indoor spaces.
